시편-123-1.title: 시편 123장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-123-1.exegesis: 8-9. In the welfare of the city, as its civil, and especially the religious relations, was involved that of Israel. now-- as in Psa 115:2 .

시편-123-2.title: 시편 123장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-123-2.exegesis: PSALM 123 Psa 123:1-4 . An earnest and expecting prayer for divine aid in distress. 1. (Compare Psa 121:1 ). thou that dwellest-- literally, "sittest as enthroned" (compare Psa 2:4 ; 113:4, 5).
시편-123-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 123 Psa 123:1-4 . An earnest and expecting prayer for divine aid in distress. 1. (Compare Psa 121:1 ). thou that dwellest-- literally, "sittest as enthroned" (compare Psa 2:4 ; 113:4, 5).

시편-123-3.title: 시편 123장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-123-3.exegesis: 2. Deference, submission, and trust, are all expressed by the figure. In the East, servants in attending on their masters are almost wholly directed by signs, which require the closest observance of the hands of the latter. The servants of God should look (1) to His directing hand, to appoint them their work; (2) to His supplying hand ( Psa 104:28 ), to give them their portion in due season; (3) to His protecting hand, to right them when wronged; (4) to His correcting hand ( Is 9:13 ; 1Pe 5:6 ; compare Ge 16:6 ); ( 5 ) to His rewarding hand.
시편-123-3.theologicalNote: 2. Deference, submission, and trust, are all expressed by the figure.
